newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin pledges efforts on EU stability pact.
newsitem.headline: Jospin pledges efforts on EU stability pact.

text.p: French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said on Tuesday that work would be done this week on the EU stability pact but declined to say whether he believed it could be agreed at a summit in Amsterdam next week.

Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok said after a meeting with Jospin that the views of France and other European partners were very similar and that foreign and finance ministers would work to reach an agreement this week.
Asked for his comments, Jospin told reporters that Kok, whose country holds the presidency of the EU, had laid out the spirit of the talks fairly well.
"There are efforts to be made. We will make them," he told reporters.
Asked whether he thought an agreement could be reached in Amsterdam, he declined to comment.
